protocol.timingBoundary: First source-chunk request through final CPU-readable PCM; excludes initialization, validation, hashing, WAV encoding and save. Optional articleCallPeakRssBytes spans the entire browser call including post-timer validation/export.

source.description: GPT-6 Luna produced an AI-assisted Standard Italian translation of the complete English benchmark fixture, preserving paragraph order and story details. Independently reviewed by AI for completeness and fidelity; no human or pronunciation review has been performed.

support.scope: Pinned Klein-TTS X1.5 Pro ONNX checkpoint
support.notes: The benchmark selects Sarah (af_heart) for English, Lucia (ef_dora) for Spanish, Camille (ff_siwis) for French, and Giulia (if_sara) for Italian.

settings.frontend: Klein-TTS upstream 0.2.0 non-English phoneme mapping and espeak-ng 1.0.2 WebAssembly CLI
settings.sentenceChunks: Upstream 250-character sentence grouping; strict vocabulary validation; recursively split at source word boundaries instead of upstream silent 510-token truncation
settings.noise: Upstream mulberry32 + Box-Muller; seed = canonical chunk id × 1024 + internal subchunk index

capability.description: Explicit one-thread WASM inference; browser eSpeak G2P is CPU work.

notes: Capability checks run separately before timing. GPU dispatch does not imply GPU-exclusive execution.
